gem_guidance.text: Hood of Hexing is available from Zul'Aman, but since it doesn't have a meta gem socket for Chaotic Skyfire Diamond , it's not even worth putting on this list. It's also relevant to this choice that Tier 5 Raids now drop three tier tokens from each respective boss, so achieving your BiS item isn't as much of a challenge anymore.
With Brilliant Lionseye , it replaces Eredar Wand of Obliteration for single-target.
With Gleaming Ornate Dawnstone or Gleaming Lionseye , it can be used instead of Eredar Wand of Obliteration for AoE.
With Great Lionseye , it can be used instead of Wand of the Forgotten Star for spell hit.

title: Burning Crusade Classic Arcane Mage DPS Best in Slot (BiS) Phase 4 Guide - Wowhead
